messages.subject: Physical USB phone found: POCO X7 Pro; Personal device-node access denied
messages.body: Actual USB sysfs metadata at22:11:59UTC identifies Xiaomi POCO X7 Pro, vendor2717/productff08, ADB Interface FF/42/01 at USB3-1, with /dev/bus/usb/003/010 present. Personal Podman UID1001/GID1002 sees that node owned65534:65534 modecrw-rw---- and os.access reports read=false/write=false, explaining empty ADB USB inventory; phone USB serial, ABI and authorization dialog remain UNKNOWN. This is fresh physical attachment evidence and replaces the old wireless blocker. I am checking the approved Orca device proxy after restoring notebook connectivity; no chmod, udev, group, privilege, key, account, host-namespace or network changes. No Root routine phone checks requested and current HTTP campaign is untouched. If no approved controller is exposed, the exact remaining boundary is Personal USB access/approved controller authority, not pairing or a phone code.
